answer: Each agent solves a memory-hard puzzle seeded by the epoch beacon and its own key, inside one shared 20-minute window. A solve holds about 4 GB of RAM for 15 minutes, so one box can't serve two IDs and a proof for one key fails for any other. 500 fakes need 2 TB rented at the same moment every epoch. Spot clouds are no haven, because that tide of demand at beacon time spikes prices. On our basalt testnet, a missed window zeroed that ID's payout.
